# sbx

> Self-hosted sandboxes for AI agents. Each sandbox is a fresh Firecracker microVM (Linux with KVM)
> or a container; idle ones sleep at 0 B of RAM and wake on the first connection from any client.
> Serves the OpenSandbox API (SDKs in five languages) and an MCP server. Also gives branches and
> test runs their own Postgres or Redis. Written in Go: one static binary, zero dependencies.

Install: `brew install aryanmehrotra/tap/sbx` or `go install github.com/aryanmehrotra/sbx@latest`.

## Docs

- [Quickstart](https://github.com/aryanmehrotra/sbx/blob/main/docs/QUICKSTART.md): first sandbox in ten minutes
- [Guides](https://github.com/aryanmehrotra/sbx/blob/main/docs/GUIDES.md): every task, one section each
- [AI agents](https://github.com/aryanmehrotra/sbx/blob/main/docs/GUIDES.md#ai-agents): the block to paste into AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md, MCP setup, OpenSandbox SDKs
- [CLI reference](https://github.com/aryanmehrotra/sbx/blob/main/docs/CLI.md): every command, flag and environment variable
- [sandbox.json reference](https://github.com/aryanmehrotra/sbx/blob/main/docs/SPEC.md)
- [Self-hosting](https://github.com/aryanmehrotra/sbx/blob/main/docs/SELF-HOSTING.md): run it on your own servers for a team
- [FAQ](https://github.com/aryanmehrotra/sbx/blob/main/docs/FAQ.md): short answers to adoption questions
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/aryanmehrotra/sbx/blob/main/docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)
- [Benchmarks](https://github.com/aryanmehrotra/sbx/blob/main/docs/BENCHMARKS.md): every number with its script and machine
